The MFSA is also responsible for the regulation and oversight of the capital markets in Malta. The MFSA also holds an advisory role to Government in the formulation of policies on matters relating to the financial services industry. In the carrying out of its functions, the MFSA collaborates closely with local and international institutions. About The Role The MFSA is seeking a highly qualified and experienced individual to join its Executive Leadership Team as Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Supervision). The primary responsibility of the Deputy Chief Executive Officer, as established at law, is to assist the Chief Executive Officer in the performance of his duties and responsibilities. The Deputy Chief Executive Officer will therefore report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the Authority from a supervisory perspective. The Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Supervision) will be responsible for leading the Authority’s sectoral supervision of the various financial services sectors. As a member of the executive leadership team, the successful candidate will drive the development and execution of the MFSA’s supervisory priorities, strengthen the effectiveness and consistency of supervisory outcomes, promote a culture of regulatory excellence, and represent the MFSA at the highest levels locally and internationally.
